scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts && vite build -c vite.bridge.config.ts && sed 's|\.\./||g' dist/public/popup.html > dist/popup.html
scripts.package: pnpm run build && Z=guardianstream-v$(node -p "require('./dist/manifest.json').version").zip && rm -f $Z && cd dist && zip -qr ../$Z . -x '*.DS_Store' 'public/*' && cd .. && echo "Packaged: $Z, $(du -h $Z | cut -f1) (CWS limit: 10MB)"
